source(output(
		GLBusUnit as string,
		DebitMBU as string,
		DebitProd as string,
		CreditMBU as string,
		CreditProd as string,
		Group as string,
		Class as string,
		Plan as string,
		ContractId as string,
		PBP as string,
		{Market Segment} as string,
		{Funding Cd} as string,
		PMP as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive({Copy of PMP} = toString(PMP)) ~> DataConversion1
DataConversion1 split((length(Copy of PMP) > 0), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Case1 derive({Copy of CreditProd} = toString(CreditProd),
		{Copy of PBP} = toString(PBP),
		{Copy of DebitMBU} = toString(DebitMBU),
		{Copy of Class} = toString(Class),
		{Copy of Group} = toString(Group),
		{Copy of DebitProd} = toString(DebitProd),
		{Copy of Plan} = toString(Plan),
		{Copy of GLBusUnit} = toString(GLBusUnit),
		{Copy of CreditMBU} = toString(CreditMBU),
		{Copy of ContractId} = toString(ContractId)) ~> DataConversion2
DataConversion2 derive(DebitAccount = 403440,
		CreditAccount = 403440,
		CreditAmt = PMP1 * (-(1))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Group as string,
		CreditMBU as string,
		DebitAmt as decimal(0,0),
		CreditAccount as integer,
		CreditProduct as string,
		CreditAmt as decimal(0,0),
		DebitMBU as string,
		DebitProduct as string,
		ContractId as string,
		DebitAccount as integer,
		Plan as string,
		GLBusUnit as string,
		MarketSegment as string,
		Class as string,
		PBP as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Group = {Copy of Group},
		CreditMBU = {Copy of CreditMBU},
		DebitAmt = PMP1,
		CreditAccount,
		CreditProduct = {Copy of CreditProd},
		CreditAmt,
		DebitMBU = {Copy of DebitMBU},
		DebitProduct = {Copy of DebitProd},
		ContractId = {Copy of ContractId},
		DebitAccount,
		Plan = {Copy of Plan},
		GLBusUnit = {Copy of GLBusUnit},
		MarketSegment = {Copy of Market Segment},
		Class = {Copy of Class},
		PBP = {Copy of PBP})) ~> OLEDBDestination
